text:
Asha (CSM): Kicking off VegaWell onboarding. Short sync to lock owners, success metrics, and 30/60-day milestones. Proposed Thu 9:30 PT (20m). Key asks from VegaWell: P0 flows validated, compliance checklist, handoff for ongoing enablement. Who's available?
Priya (VegaWell PO): Thu 9:30 PT works. Quick note: renewal conversation scheduled in ~11 months — want to track "early value" signals for renewal health. Can we capture 3 signals we can report weekly?
Asha (CSM): Good flag — let's track (1) usage of two core flows, (2) error rate on staging ingest, (3) time-to-first-successful-inference. We'll add these to the success dashboard.
Liam (Solutions Eng): On integration: need sandbox API key, sample payloads (sanitized), and expected throughput. If VegaWell expects >50 req/s we need to pre-configure dedicated capacity or set expectations. @Priya can you share expected QPS?
Priya (VegaWell PO): Initial peak expected ~20–30 qps, steady-state 5–10 qps. We'll provide sample payloads Monday.
Dmitri (Enablement): I'll prepare a 25-min playbook: 10-min demo, 10-min runbook walkthrough, 5-min QA. Will include KB entries for masking, KMS, and trace collection. Can record and share.
Asha (CSM): Owners checklist draft before the sync:
- VegaWell: provide sanitized sample data (owner: Priya)
- Eng: staging ingest + sample inference (owner: Liam)
- Enablement: demo + runbook (owner: Dmitri)
- CS: weekly health email + dashboard (owner: Asha)
- Security/compliance: data retention & masking signoff (owner: Priya)
Priya (VegaWell PO): Agree. For retention, we need default 30d retention with optional purge on request. Is that supported?
Liam (Solutions Eng): Yes — can enforce TTL in ingestion pipeline and confirm purge API. I'll draft a small curl example for purge and post it. Example auth snippet (staging):
```bash
# staging
export RW_API_KEY=stg-abc123
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"sample"}' \
  https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Dmitri (Enablement): For the runbook, I'll add a short section: "Masking verification steps" and a troubleshooting table for common ingestion errors.
Asha (CSM): Risks to call out now (for the kickoff):
- Data approval delay (impact: blocks staging ingest)
- Billing/quotas mismatch (impact: throttling in staging)
- Compliance checklist incomplete (impact: delayed handoff)
We'll tag owners and mitigation steps during the meeting.
Priya (VegaWell PO): Re: billing — can we get an estimate of token/unit costs for typical flows? Needed for forecasting.
Asha (CSM): I'll pull cost estimates after Liam shares sample payloads and expected traffic; we'll include in the weekly health email.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "VegaWell onboarding intake (20m)" Thu 09:30 PT. Invitees: Asha, Priya, Liam, Dmitri.
Asha (CSM): Great. I'll drop a 1-pager (goals + pre-reqs) in the channel 2 hours before the meeting and add a follow-up 30/60-day milestone doc. Quick 30/60 targets to review in sync:
- 30d: staging ingest + two core flows validated, recorded demo delivered, dashboard with 3 health signals
- 60d: production rollout plan agreed, SLA targets captured, baseline latency & cost metrics
Priya (VegaWell PO): Sounds good. Appreciate the early-value focus for renewal tracking.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll queue the staging deploy once I get the sample. Expect a test endpoint within 3 business days after sample.
Dmitri (Enablement): Recording + runbook will be uploaded to the shared KB and I'll ping the channel.
Asha (CSM): Thanks—closing the loop. See you Thu. :white_check_mark:
